annotations.title: Start a maintenance window on a site now

description: Wraps POST /api/sites/{slug}/maintenance/start. Start a maintenance window on a site now. Call this before a deploy: alerts for the site are held (checks still run) until the window ends, after `minutes` (default 30, at most 24 hours) or when you end it. Starting again replaces the open window. It acts for the whole team. Needs a Member or Admin key, on a team with 10 sites or more.
